items.reason: Verified in held text (63 Stat. 802, sha 4d63176a...): sec. 531(b)(34) repeals the 1942 Act except sec. 12 and the travel-status part of sec. 10 par. 1; sec. 531(c)(12) repeals those, effective Jan. 1, 1950 by sec. 533(c); sec. 533(a) general effective date Oct. 1, 1949; sec. 303(h) continues pre-Act travel allowances 'until such regulations are issued', a date in no held source. So the own-terms end 1950-06-30 cannot be confirmed as first end, and an earlier end cannot be dated. Sec. 520 savings concerns pay entitlements and does not settle the order's continuance. The TERM records for the statutes carry mechanism own_terms_condition and actor EO:10061, so citing them for a statutory end would mislabel it; blocking rather than mislabeling is correct.
items.fetch_lines_judgment: Both appended FETCH lines are right: (1) the sec. 303(h) Secretaries' travel regulations with issue/effective date is the missing fact; (2) 60 Stat. 853, 858 is needed to identify the as-amended travel-status text. No FETCH needed for EO 10084/10098/10118 (already held in jobs/fr-originals); their gap is a kit gap (no ACT record because they do not name EO 9871), correctly reported.
items.d6: Searched: CCA secs. 303(h), 520, 531(b)(34), 531(c)(12), 533 in the held statute; EO 10084 text in jobs/fr-originals (adopts existing EO regulations under the 1942 Act as CCA regulations from Oct. 1, 1949) and existence of EO 10098 and 10118 there. Later events that may have ended or changed the clauses before 1950-06-30 (CCA repeal of authority; EO 10084 adoption as possible 'sooner modified') were not ignored: the producer surfaced them and they are the reason for the block. No later event was removed.
